Higher Education Committee
Thursday, March 21, 2024
3:00 PM, G-15 Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:11pm

Call to order

S.F. 3945: Senator Putnam: Higher education previous appropriations modifications.

Senator Putnam moved that S.F. 3945, be recommended to pass and re-referred to the Finance Committee. - MOTION PREVAILED.
S.F. 4003: Senator Fateh: Certain higher education provisions technical and policy changes.

Gavel transferred to Vice Chair Putnam at 3:14pm
The following individuals testified on S.F.4003:
-Commissioner Dennis Olson, Office of Higher
Education

-Kristin Burgess, Director of Accessibility Resources,
Metropolitan State University

-Ziigwan Frazer, Policy and Advocacy Manager, Foster
Advocates

-Marwah Asif, State Chair, Students United
-Jonathan Bohn, Director of Public Affairs,
Inter-Faculty Organization

-Mark Grant, Director of Government Relations,
Minnesota State College Faculty

Senator Fateh moved the A4 amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

Senator Fateh moved the A5 amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Rarick moved the Aé amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED
Senator Fateh moved the A8 amendment to the amendment, MOTION ADOPTED

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 4003, as amended, be recommended to pass. - MOTION ADOPTED.

The meeting was adjourned at 4:24pm
